summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To facilitate reflection-level scaling, we construct GenRef, a large-scale dataset comprising 1 million triplets, each containing a reflection, a flawed image, and...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Leveraging this dataset, we efficiently perform reflection tuning on state-of-the-art diffusion transformer,...；Experimental results show that ReflectionFlow significantly outperforms naive noise-level scaling methods,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 15 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Vidi: Large Multimodal Models for Video Understanding and Editing
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈、对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Vidi** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖多模态与统一基座（Multimodal）。核心论点主张：In this report, we introduce Vidi, a family of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for a wide range of video understand editing scenarios。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Remarkably, Vidi significantly outperforms leading proprietary models, e.g., GPT-4o and Gemini, on the temporal retrieval task, indicating its superiority in video editing scenarios）。

summaries.title: IPBench: Benchmarking the Knowledge of Large Language Models in Intellectual Property
